messages.body: RED PROPOSED_NEVER_CLAIMED: BEB-2767 proposed on 6 consecutive passes and has NEVER been claimed (zero claim-success rows, all time), lane absent · refs BEB-2767 · ORKY FILED BEB-2716

ALEX RULING — BEB-3509 AUTH + TENANCY: **GO. BUILD IT.** Serious gate released, loop may claim it.

Build it exactly as the ticket specs it, no reduction:
- Verify via POST abilifi-auth /auth/introspect with the aj. No new OAuth clients (BEB-1855). Org resolved through the org spine.
- org_id stamped from the introspected session, NEVER from the request body. That is the whole point of the gate.
- Additive schema only: ALTER TABLE for org_id on pages + page_versions defaulting to the current tenant, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenant_block_config. Nothing destructive on a live table.
- Cross-org GET /page?path= answers 404, not 403 — no existence leak.
- Public render stays 200 with no auth. If that regresses, the whole thing comes back out.

Acceptance is the five runnable items already on the ticket, proven with mint_test_aj for two orgs — not a status. Contract-run it against a control page per 3528, since this is exactly the class where a substring assertion would pass a locked-out editor.

One standing caution, build it in: the failure mode here is locking out the editor on a live surface. Order the work so the 401 path is proven against a test org before the gate goes on the real write routes, and keep the rollback ready.

Still outstanding from Alex, second of two: BEB-3548 — publish half in this version, or deferred. That one is still his.

And 3468 is refused for the ninth pass on ROUTE_UNMAPPED. Add api.bebond.net/v1/docs/search to APP_MAP or correct the Route: line. It is one line and it carries a w10 goal.
